```{r load packages}

library(patchwork)
```

```{r data read in and processing}
#| cache: true 
#| include: false

# --- accel data ----- # 
walking = read_rds(here::here("data", "walking.rds"))
driving = read_rds(here::here("data", "driving.rds"))
cooking = read_rds(here::here("data", "cooking.rds"))

# --- pa data --- # 
nh_pa = read_rds(here::here("data", "covariates_pa_valid.rds"))
nh_pa = nh_pa |> 
  filter(valid_accel, age_in_years_at_screening >= 18) |> 
  mutate(age_cat = cut(age_in_years_at_screening, breaks = c(18, 29, 39, 49, 59, 69, Inf), include.lowest = TRUE),
         age_cat = factor(age_cat, labels = c("18-29", "30-39", "40-49", "50-59", "60-69", "70+"))) |> 
  rename(age = age_in_years_at_screening)


mims_sl = read_rds(here::here("data", "mims_covariates.rds"))
# add age cat
mims_sl = 
  mims_sl |> 
  filter(age_in_years_at_screening >= 18) |> 
   mutate(age_cat = cut(age_in_years_at_screening, breaks = c(18, 29, 39, 49, 59, 69, Inf), include.lowest = TRUE),
         age_cat = factor(age_cat, labels = c("18-29", "30-39", "40-49", "50-59", "60-69", "70+")))

```

```{r ggplot theme}
#| include: false

font_add_google("Libre Franklin", "Libre Franklin")

      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),

      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, color = "#000000"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 14, color = "#444444"),
      strip.background = element_rect(fill = "darkgrey", color = NA),
      strip.text = element_text(color = "white", size = 12)
    )
)
```

## Introduction: accelerometry data 

```{r accel plot}
#| cache: true
img_plot = ggplot() +
  ggimage::geom_image(aes(x = 0.5, y = 0.5, image = here::here("docs/figs/actigraph.png")), size = 1) +
  theme_void() + 
  theme(
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#f6f5f3", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#f6f5f3", color = NA)
    )


p1 = 
  driving %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = t, y = vm))+
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, color = "#002D72")+
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = "Time (s)", y = "Acceleration (g = 9.81m/s²)") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0,10,1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.5, 1.75)) + 
  annotate(geom = "label", x = 5, y = 1.5, label = "Driving (passenger)", size = 8, color = "#002D72")

p2 = 
  cooking %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = t, y = vm))+
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, color = "#008767")+
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = "Time (s)", y = "Acceleration (g = 9.81m/s²)") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0,10,1)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.5, 1.75)) +
  annotate(geom = "label", x = 5, y = 1.5, label = "Cooking", size = 8, color = "#008767")


p3 = 
  walking %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = t, y = vm))+
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, color = "#A45C98")+
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = "Time (s)", y = "Acceleration (g = 9.81m/s²)") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,10,1)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.5, 1.75)) +
  annotate(geom = "label", x = 5, y = 1.5, label = "Walking", size = 8, color = "#A45C98")



plot_grid(img_plot, NULL, align = "v", rel_widths = c(1,1), ncol = 2)
```

## Introduction: accelerometry data 

```{r accel plot w fig}
#| cache: true


p1a = p1 / p2 / p3 + plot_layout(guides = "collect", axes = "collect")

plot_grid(img_plot, p1a, align = "v", rel_widths = c(1,1), ncol = 2)
```

## What can we do with this data? 

::: {.incremental}

+ Physical activity assessment
+ Activity recognition
+ Weird stuff: person identification 

::: 

---

### Physical activity assessment 

How many steps do Americans take? 

```{r}
nh_pa |>
  ggplot(aes(x = 1, y = total_scsslsteps, fill = gender)) +
  geom_violin(quantile.linetype = "dashed") +
  facet_grid(.~age_cat, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(x = "Age Category", y = "Total Daily Steps (x1000)") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#3299FFFF", "#FF9932FF"), name = "") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 35000, 5000), labels = seq(0, 35, 5)) +
  theme_sub_axis_x(text = element_blank(), 
                   ticks = element_blank(),
                   title = element_blank())
```

---

### Physical activity assessment 

How many steps do Americans take? 


```{r}
nh_pa |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = age, y = total_scsslsteps, color = gender, fill = gender)) +
  geom_smooth() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#3299FFFF", "#FF9932FF"), name = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#3299FFFF", "#FF9932FF"), name = "") +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 35000, 1000), labels = seq(0, 35, 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(20, 80, 5)) +
  labs(x = "Age", y = "Total Daily Steps (x1000)") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

```

### Association with mortality 


```{r}
#| echo: true 

data_50 = 
  nh_pa |> 
  filter(age >= 50 & !is.na(mortstat)) |> 
  mutate(weight_adj = full_sample_2_year_mec_exam_weight / 2,
         weight_norm = weight_adj / mean(weight_adj),
         steps = total_scsslsteps / 1000)
         
death_model = glm(mortstat ~ steps + age + cat_bmi + gender, data = data_50, family = binomial(), weights = weight_norm)

```

```{r}
stargazer::stargazer(death_model, apply.coef = exp, type = "text", ci = TRUE, report = c("vcs*"), single.row = TRUE)

```

---

### What about within day physical activity patterns? 

```{r}
df_tf = mims_sl %>%
  mutate(
    # tfd() needs a matrix of the minute columns
    activity = tfd(as.matrix(select(., starts_with("min_"))), arg = 1:1440)) %>%
  select(age_cat, gender, activity)
df_tf |> 
  group_by(age_cat, gender) |>
  summarize(mean_mims = mean(activity, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  tf_ggplot(aes(tf = mean_mims, color = gender)) +
  geom_smooth(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_grid(~age_cat) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#3299FFFF", "#FF9932FF")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1440, 360),
                     labels = c("00:00", "06:00", "12:00", "18:00", "")) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 40, size = 10)) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
  labs(x = "Time of day", y = "Physical activity (MIMS)", color = "")
```
